cookieConsent.bannerDescription: We use cookies to improve your experience, analyze traffic, and personalize content. You can accept all or manage your preferences.
cookieConsent.prefsDescription: Manage cookie categories. Essential cookies are always active — they are required for the site to function.
cookieConsent.essentialDesc: Login, cart, security. The site cannot function without these.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: PostHog — we anonymously measure how you use the site to improve it.
cookieConsent.marketingDesc: Meta and Google advertising pixels. They help us show more relevant ads.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Learn about the cookies we use, their purpose, and how long they are stored.
cookiePolicy.intro: This page explains which cookies and tracking technologies we use on EventApp, their purpose, and how long they are stored.
cookiePolicy.essentialDescription: These cookies are required for the site to function properly. They cannot be disabled.
cookiePolicy.analyticsDescription: These cookies help us understand how users interact with the site so we can improve it.
cookiePolicy.posthogCookiePurpose: PostHog — anonymous usage analytics, session recording
cookiePolicy.marketingDescription: These cookies enable personalized ads based on your interests.
cookiePolicy.fbpCookiePurpose: Meta Pixel — conversion tracking and remarketing
cookiePolicy.managingDescription: You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the "Manage cookies" link in the footer. You can also delete cookies from your browser settings.
